parallels.note: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of heaven quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

translations.web: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
translations.bsb: Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
translations.kjv: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
translations.asv: Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations also of the mountains quaked And were shaken, because he was wroth.
